# Piano

> Piano provides data-driven customer engagement solutions for digital revenue optimization.

Piano provides an integrated platform for analytics, audience management, activation, and content amplification — serving media, publishing, financial services, healthcare, and transportation industries worldwide.

- [Documentation](https://docs.piano.io/)
- [Request a Demo](https://www.piano.io/request-a-demo)

## Products

- [Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation): Piano Activation is a digital revenue optimization platform that helps businesses segment, engage, and convert audiences into loyal customers through personalized customer experiences.
- [Piano Activation - Identity Management Platform](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/identity-management): Piano's Identity Management is a complete user management solution that helps businesses collect and manage user data through authentication.
- [Auth Sync](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/identity-management/auth-sync): Auth Sync is Piano's identity management solution that complements your identity architecture with integrated platform segmentation, targeting and user management.
- [Progressive Profiling - Identity Management | Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/identity-management/progressive-profiling): Piano's Progressive Profiling solution enables businesses to gradually collect customer data over time through identity management.
- [Journey Orchestration Platform | Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration): Piano's Journey Orchestration platform enables businesses to segment audiences with speed and personalize customer experiences with precision.
- [A/B Testing - Journey Orchestration | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/ab-testing): Piano's A/B Testing solution enables businesses to test and optimize content recommendations, landing pages, and user experiences at scale.
- [Activation Insights - Journey Orchestration | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/activation-insights): Piano's Activation Insights is a journey orchestration solution that provides data-driven customer engagement capabilities.
- [Content Recommendations - Journey Orchestration](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/content-recommendations): Piano's Content Recommendations is an AI-powered engagement tool that helps maintain audience engagement by tailoring content according to visitor behavior.
- [Journey Analysis - Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/journey-analysis): Piano's Journey Analysis provides unparalleled insights into customer journeys through comprehensive data analysis including conversion rates, traffic distribution, real-time activity and A/B testing.
- [Piano Activation - Subscription Management](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management): Piano's Subscription Management solution is a comprehensive e-commerce engine designed for content businesses.
- [Piano Activation - Access Control](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/access-control): Piano's Access Control solution provides sophisticated subscription management capabilities that enable businesses to control and manage user access to digital content.
- [Enterprise Subscriptions - Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/enterprise-subscriptions): Piano's Enterprise Subscriptions solution enables businesses to sell and manage subscriptions to companies, universities, libraries, and institutions.
- [External Licensing - Subscription Management | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/external-licensing): Piano's external licensing feature enables seamless management of digital access across multiple channels including websites, mobile apps, native apps, devices, and print subscriptions.
- [Flexible Pricing - Subscription Management | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/flexible-pricing): Piano's flexible pricing solution offers innovative and adaptable subscription management with diverse term types, dynamic pricing, and resource mapping.
- [Integrated Payments - Piano Subscription Management](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/integrated-payments): Piano's Integrated Payments solution provides a powerful payment platform with multiple transaction methods to reduce friction when transacting with clients.
- [Localization & Tax Reporting - Piano Subscription Management](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/localization-and-tax-reporting): Piano's subscription management platform provides comprehensive localization and tax reporting features for global transactions.
- [Piano Print Subscriptions](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/print-subscriptions): Piano's Print Subscriptions solution combines physical fulfillment with digital capabilities, enabling publishers to manage print and digital subscriptions through a unified platform.
- [Promo Codes - Subscription Management | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/promo-codes): Piano's promo code feature enables businesses to drive customer acquisition, retention, and revenue through customizable promotional offers.
- [Revenue Recognition - Subscription Management | Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/revenue-recognition): Piano's revenue recognition solution helps businesses accurately track and manage subscription revenue in compliance with accounting standards.
- [Piano Amplifier](https://www.piano.io/product/amplifier): Piano Amplifier is a content distribution and optimization platform that streamlines social media strategy to maximize audience engagement.
- [Piano Amplifier - Campaign Optimization](https://www.piano.io/product/amplifier/campaign-optimization): Piano's Campaign Optimization service provides expert paid social campaign management to maximize reach and ROI.
- [Piano Amplifier - Newsletters & Notifications](https://www.piano.io/product/amplifier/newsletters-notifications): Piano Amplifier's Newsletters & Notifications automates audience engagement and content distribution through personalized email campaigns and web push notifications.
- [Piano Amplifier - Social Media Distribution](https://www.piano.io/product/amplifier/social-media-distribution): Piano Amplifier's Social Media Distribution is an AI-powered publishing tool designed to grow and engage audiences through real-time data and machine-learning optimization.
- [Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics): Piano Analytics is a powerful, compliant, and accurate behavioral analytics platform that provides advanced data collection and analysis capabilities.
- [Ad Revenue Insights with Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/ad-revenue-insights): Piano's Ad Revenue Insights is an analytics solution that enables publishers to precisely measure the revenue their ads generate at the impression level.
- [Data Democratization with Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-democratization): Piano Analytics' Data Democratization capability provides elegant, flexible, and personalized data exploration and collaboration tools across organizations.
- [Anomaly Detection - Piano Analytics | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-democratization/anomaly-detection): Piano's Anomaly Detection feature helps organizations democratize data by automatically identifying unusual patterns and irregularities in analytics data.
- [Journey Analysis - Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-democratization/journey-analysis): Piano's journey analysis tool provides a comprehensive toolset for mapping and analyzing user journeys across digital channels, platforms, and devices.
- [Piano Analytics Data Management](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-management): Piano Analytics Data Management provides comprehensive data collection, transformation, and governance solutions for digital businesses.
- [Piano Analytics Data Mining](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-mining): Piano Analytics Data Mining is an advanced query builder and data extraction tool that leverages machine learning to combine and extract data simply and quickly without coding.
- [Data Sources | Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources): Piano Analytics integrates pre-integrated and proprietary datasets that power industry-specific analysis.
- [Ad Performance Data Sources - Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/ad-performance): Piano Analytics offers comprehensive ad performance data sources for tracking and measuring advertising effectiveness.
- [AV Insights - Piano Analytics Data Sources](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/av-insights): AV Insights is a data source integration for Piano Analytics that enables comprehensive tracking and analysis of audio and video content engagement.
- [Activation Insights (Composer Insights) - Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/composer-insights): Activation Insights is a subscription analytics product by Piano that helps businesses understand their subscription performance, track the subscriber journey, and optimize conversion rates.
- [Piano Sales Insights](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/sales-insights): Piano Sales Insights provides actionable analytics for e-commerce businesses to understand shopping funnel performance and optimize product catalogs.
- [Piano Analytics Data Unification Platform](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-unification): Piano Analytics Data Unification is an open platform that disseminates and connects data streams across your organization.
- [Piano Connect](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-unification/piano-connect): Piano Connect is a data unification and marketing analytics solution that provides an unbiased, objective view of advertising performance and spend data.
- [Piano Analytics powered by Snowflake](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-unification/snowflake): Piano Analytics leverages Snowflake's data warehouse architecture to provide real-time customer behavior analysis and data unification.
- [Piano Audience](https://www.piano.io/product/audience): Piano Audience is a customer data platform that helps digital businesses ingest and enhance visitor data from any source for segmentation, analytics, targeting, and machine learning.
- [Piano Customer Data Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/audience/customer-data-activation): Piano Audience's Customer Data Activation delivers new speed and transparency to help bring your customer data to life.
- [Piano Audience - Customer Data Integration Platform](https://www.piano.io/product/audience/customer-data-integration): Piano Audience is a customer data integration platform that enables organizations to populate and enrich customer records with comprehensive data including device behavior, content profiles, consent management, and progressive profiling.
- [Piano Audience Customer Data Segmentation](https://www.piano.io/product/audience/customer-data-segmentation): Piano Audience offers customer data segmentation tools that enable businesses to create highly relevant audience segments for targeting, analytics, and export.
- [Building on Piano: Custom Solutions for Your Business](https://www.piano.io/product/building-on-piano): Piano provides an ideal foundation for proprietary business applications, enabling clients to build unique, differentiated capabilities leveraging its feature-rich platform.
- [Piano Platform Overview | Integrated Data and Engagement Tools](https://www.piano.io/product/platform-overview): Piano is an integrated platform designed to help digital-first organizations attract, engage, convert, manage, and retain customers.

## Industries

- [Financial Services Solutions | Piano](https://www.piano.io/industry/financial-services): Piano provides comprehensive customer data and analytics solutions for financial services companies.
- [Healthcare Solutions | Piano](https://www.piano.io/industry/healthcare): Piano offers privacy-first analytics built specifically for healthcare teams.
- [Media & Publishing Solutions | Piano for Publishers](https://www.piano.io/industry/media): Piano provides comprehensive media and publishing solutions used by over 600 leading companies worldwide.
- [Piano Professional Services](https://www.piano.io/industry/media/professional-services): Piano Professional Services provides expert guidance and support to help clients maximize their Piano software investment and accelerate digital growth.
- [Transportation Industry Solutions | Piano](https://www.piano.io/industry/transportation): Piano provides transportation industry solutions that help personalize offer presentations and drive higher sales and ancillary revenue per customer.

## Resources

- [Piano Resources Center | Explore Our Knowledge Hub](https://www.piano.io/resources): Piano's comprehensive resource center featuring articles, case studies, reports, guides, videos, and webinars on analytics, audience engagement, subscriptions, data management, and privacy compliance.
- [Articles | Piano Resources](https://www.piano.io/resources/articles): Browse Piano's comprehensive collection of articles covering digital analytics, audience engagement, subscription strategies, privacy compliance, and data-driven business insights.
- [Case Studies | Piano Resources](https://www.piano.io/resources/case-studies): Explore Piano's collection of customer success stories and case studies showcasing how leading organizations use Piano's analytics, subscription management, and audience engagement solutions.
- [Reports & Guides | Piano Resources](https://www.piano.io/resources/reports-guides): Access Piano's comprehensive collection of reports and guides covering digital publishing, subscription strategies, analytics, audience engagement, and data management.
- [Videos | Piano Resources](https://www.piano.io/resources/videos): Browse Piano's video resources covering topics like analytics, audience engagement, subscription management, data privacy, AI in media, and customer success stories.
- [Webinars | Piano Resources](https://www.piano.io/resources/webinars): Browse Piano's collection of webinars covering topics like subscription growth, audience engagement, analytics, personalization, churn prevention, and revenue optimization.

## Company

- [Piano Software Inc.](https://www.piano.io/company/about-us): Piano is a technology company specializing in data and customer engagement solutions that improve digital interactions between companies and their customers.
- [Careers at Piano | Join Our Global Team](https://www.piano.io/company/careers): Explore career opportunities at Piano, a global technology company offering diverse roles for passionate innovators.
- [Piano Leadership Team | Meet Our Innovators](https://www.piano.io/company/leadership): Meet the leadership team at Piano Software Inc., including our executive innovators who guide the company's vision in customer data integration, analytics, and activation solutions.
- [Piano Partner Network | Strategic Partnerships for Growth](https://www.piano.io/company/partners): Join Piano's global network of technology and service partners.
- [Service Partners | Piano Partners](https://www.piano.io/company/partners/service-partners): Piano's Service Partners are trusted advisors who guide clients on their journey to success through seamless onboarding, comprehensive training, ongoing support, and platform optimization.
- [Piano Partner Program - Service Partners](https://www.piano.io/company/partners/service-partners/partner-program): Join Piano's exclusive partner program to build cutting-edge services on their market-leading SaaS platform for Total Revenue Optimization.
- [Piano Technology Partners | Strategic Partnerships for Growth](https://www.piano.io/company/partners/technology-partners): Piano's Technology Partners expand the boundaries of what's possible by integrating their technologies with Piano's platform.
- [Why Choose Piano? | Trusted Data & Experience Platform](https://www.piano.io/company/why-piano): Piano is a trusted data and experience platform focused on craftsmanship, community, and compliance.

## General

- [Privacy + Compliance | Piano](https://www.piano.io/compliance): Piano's comprehensive compliance and data privacy information page.
- [Sign Up for Piano's Newsletter | Stay Updated](https://www.piano.io/newsletter): Subscribe to Piano's newsletter to stay ahead of the curve with the latest news, product announcements, research reports, case studies, and best practices.
- [Partner with Piano | Apply Today](https://www.piano.io/partner-up): Join the Piano Partner Network by filling out a quick application form.
- [Request a Demo | See Piano in Action](https://www.piano.io/request-a-demo): Connect with Piano to see a live demonstration of their platform.
- [Piano Services | Comprehensive Solutions for Data & Engagement](https://www.piano.io/services): Piano offers comprehensive professional services to help clients maximize their platform investment, including implementation support, technical consulting, strategic services, campaign management, and training.

## Optional

Japanese-language versions of key pages.

- [Piano - Professional Services for Media Industry | Data-Driven Customer Engagement Solutions](https://www.piano.io/industry/media/professional-services/ja): Piano provides data-driven customer engagement solutions specifically tailored for professional services in the media industry.
- [Auth Sync - Identity Management | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/identity-management/auth-sync/ja): Auth Sync is Piano's identity management solution that enables seamless authentication synchronization across platforms.
- [プログレッシブプロファイリング](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/identity-management/progressive-profiling/ja): Pianoのプログレッシブプロファイリングソリューションは、グローバルなプライバシー基準を順守しながら1stパーティデータを段階的に取得し、ユーザーの興味や好みに基づいたパーソナライズされたエクスペリエンスを提供します。ユーザージャーニーの適切なタイミングでデータを収集し、効果的なターゲティングとオーディエンスセグメント化を実現します。
- [A/B Testing - Journey Orchestration | Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/ab-testing/ja): Piano's A/B testing capabilities within Journey Orchestration enable data-driven customer engagement through experimentation and optimization.
- [Activation Insights - Journey Orchestration | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/activation-insights/ja): Activation Insights is a feature of Piano's Journey Orchestration product that provides data-driven analytics and intelligence to optimize customer engagement strategies.
- [Content recommendations - Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/content-recommendations/ja): PianoのAIによるコンテンツレコメンデーション機能は、サイト訪問者の行動に合わせてコンテンツをカスタマイズし、オーディエンスのエンゲージメントを維持します。スマートレコメンデーション、協調フィルタリング、トップコンテンツ、コンテクスチュアル・ターゲティングなどの自動最適化機能により、定着率や再訪を促進します。
- [Journey Analysis - Piano Activation Journey Orchestration](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/journey-orchestration/journey-analysis/ja): Piano's Journey Analysis provides data-driven customer engagement solutions that enable businesses to analyze and optimize customer journeys through comprehensive orchestration capabilities.
- [Piano アクセス管理](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/access-control/ja): Pianoのアクセス管理ソリューションは、ペイウォールや会員登録ウォールを簡素化し、プレミアムコンテンツやオファーへのアクセスを制御します。独自のアクセスルールの定義、カスタマイズ可能なオファーテンプレート、Composerとの統合によるパーソナライズされた体験、そして詳細なアクセスレポートログを提供します。
- [Enterprise Subscriptions - Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/enterprise-subscriptions/ja): Pianoのエンタープライズサブスクリプション管理ソリューションは、企業、大学、図書館、その他の公共・民間機関向けにサブスクリプションを販売・管理します。IPアドレス、メールドメイン、または事前定義されたリストに基づいてエンドユーザーにアクセスを提供し、ユーザー管理の簡素化、柔軟なアクセス制御、サイトライセンス機能、充実したレポート機能、支払い連携などを実現します。
- [External Licensing - Subscription Management | Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/external-licensing/ja): Piano provides data-driven customer engagement solutions with external licensing capabilities as part of their subscription management system.
- [Flexible Pricing - Subscription Management | Piano](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/flexible-pricing/ja): Piano's flexible pricing solution enables businesses to create and manage dynamic pricing strategies for their subscription offerings.
- [連携決済 - Piano 統合決済ソリューション](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/integrated-payments/ja): Pianoの連携決済は、クレジットカード、Apple Pay、Google Pay、キャリア決済など80を超える機能連携と35以上の支払い方法に対応する包括的な決済管理プラットフォームです。グローバルコンプライアンス、セキュリティ、不正行為防止機能を備え、シームレスな決済エクスペリエンスを提供します。
- [Localization and Tax Reporting - Piano Activation Subscription Management](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/localization-and-tax-reporting/ja): Piano's localization and tax reporting capabilities enable businesses to manage global subscriptions with multi-language support and automated tax compliance.
- [Promo Codes - Subscription Management - Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/promo-codes/ja): Piano's promo code functionality within the subscription management system enables businesses to create and manage promotional discount codes for customer acquisition and retention.
- [Revenue Recognition - Subscription Management - Piano Activation](https://www.piano.io/product/activation/subscription-management/revenue-recognition/ja): Piano offers revenue recognition capabilities as part of its subscription management solution within the Activation product suite.
- [瞬時の異常検知 - Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-democratization/anomaly-detection/ja): Pianoの異常検知機能は、データのポジティブな異常とネガティブな異常の両方をプロアクティブに検知して対処します。AI分析と機械学習を活用し、リアルタイムのアラート設定で問題を未然に把握し、トラブルを防止します。チーム連携機能により、検知された異常の共有と履歴管理が可能です。
- [カスタマージャーニー分析](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-democratization/journey-analysis/ja): Pianoのカスタマージャーニー分析ツールは、様々なプラットフォームとデバイスでユーザーがどのように行動しているのか、その複雑なプロセス全体をセッション単位、日単位、週単位、月単位で把握可能にします。ナビゲーションパターンの分析と、フルカスタマイズ可能なファネルを作成し、コンバージョン率を最適化できる包括的なツールセットを提供します。
- [Piano Analytics - 広告パフォーマンス](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/ad-performance/ja): Piano Analyticsの広告パフォーマンス機能は、マーケティングの成果と支出データを一元化し、広告投資による成果と収益を明確に可視化します。Google Adsなどの主要プラットフォームのデータを集約し、公平な計測による信頼性の高いインサイトとROAS分析を提供することで、キャンペーンの効果測定と改善を実現します。
- [AV Insights - Data Sources | Piano Analytics](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/av-insights/ja): Piano's AV Insights is a data source within Piano Analytics that enables organizations to gather and analyze audio-visual content engagement data.
- [Composer Insights - Piano Analytics Data Sources](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/composer-insights/ja): Composer Insights is a data source feature within Piano Analytics that enables organizations to track and analyze user engagement with Piano Composer experiences.
- [Sales Insights - Piano Analytics Data Sources](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-sources/sales-insights/ja): Piano offers data-driven customer engagement solutions with analytics capabilities including sales insights as a data source.
- [Piano Connect](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-unification/piano-connect/ja): Piano Connectはデータ統合ソリューションで、顧客エンゲージメントのためのデータドリブンな分析を提供します。Piano Analyticsの一部として、様々なデータソースを統合し、顧客データを一元化することで、より効果的なデータ活用を実現します。
- [Piano Analytics, powered by Snowflake](https://www.piano.io/product/analytics/data-unification/snowflake/ja): Piano AnalyticsとSnowflakeの統合により、顧客行動をリアルタイムで分析し、パーソナライズを次のレベルへ。信頼性の高いデータへの迅速なアクセス、顧客データの一元化、データ共有機能を提供し、組織全体で共通のユーザー中心の視点に基づいたデータ活用を実現します。
